expert_references.source: Espressif ESP-IDF v4.4 ESP32 Kconfig documentation
expert_references.material_fact: CONFIG_NEWLIB_NANO_FORMAT enables nano printf; 64-bit integer formats are unsupported. This corroborates the pinned sdkconfig and malformed %llu trace evidence.

Sample percentiles are order-statistic estimates; a larger frame sample gives more observations in the upper 1% tail. The proposed sample-count arithmetic is an inference and does not remove frame autocorrelation or guarantee rare-event recurrence.

stage_summary.interpretation: R7 kernel average is 0.558026 ms higher and kernel p95 0.25 ms higher. The R7 per-pixel composeVibeColor call executes inside the measured render/kernel path, so it is a plausible source of this modest sustained kernel cost, not a proven cause. AUX-prepare average rises 3.820484 ms while unaccounted average falls 3.760752 ms; their combined delta is only 0.059732 ms, consistent with timing bucket attribution moving rather than a comparable whole-frame penalty.

verified_r2.trace_stage_attribution: INVALID: all five records are malformed; no R2 same-frame stage cost may be used

verified_differences.evidence: R7 onset window uptime 1408-1438 s; R2 windows uptime 487-543 s and 569-625 s.
verified_differences.interpretation: R2 did not sample near the R7 observed onset age; this is a confound, not proof of age-caused regression.

verified_differences.evidence: R7 cumulative tail count grows 224 at uptime 1408 to 1441 by uptime 1438. R2 final populations are 2948 and 2913 frames while host polling lasted 60.354 s and 60.352 s; R2 first poll already had 591/546 frames, so each cumulative percentile includes frames before the first host sample.
verified_differences.interpretation: The p99 estimates use unequal populations and differing reset/pre-window boundaries; they are not equivalent samples.

verified_differences.evidence: R7 and R2 both kernel 13/Caleido3, variant 1347100685, brightness 44; R2 CPU readback/trace was 240 MHz.
verified_differences.interpretation: These named conditions match. R7 CPU frequency readback and all audio/motion controls are not present in the compared R7 sampling record, so full runtime equivalence is unverified.

verified_differences.evidence: R7 used 25 valid telemetry reads over about 30 s, about once per second, each reported read around 0.15-0.20 s. R2 used 8 matched safety polls over 60.35 s, five parallel read-only endpoints per poll; observed per-endpoint latency varied and Matrix info reached 2.439 s.
verified_differences.interpretation: Observation load differs; endpoint latency is recorded but has no frame-level timestamp correlation, so it cannot explain the tail.

verified_differences.evidence: Both data sets report native WLED live DDP sourced from Matrix. R7/R2 HBNF projection frame-lock RX fields are stale/inactive/invalid; they are a distinct projection telemetry path and not evidence that WLED native DDP stopped. Physical AUX LEDs are not observable from WLED JSON.
verified_differences.interpretation: No demonstrated AUX transport failure explains the Matrix p99.

verified_differences.evidence: R7 free heap was roughly 107-117 KB with lifetime minimum 49,048 bytes; R2 free heap was roughly 105-116 KB with lifetime minimum 47,932 bytes. R7 scheduler p95 was 2.125 ms; R2 1.875 ms. R7 kernel average delta vs R4 was +0.558 ms and kernel p95 +0.25 ms; AUX-prepare +3.820 ms was largely offset by unaccounted -3.761 ms. R2 arm/disarm p99 delta was -0.25 ms, max delta -7.452 ms, median FPS delta 0.
verified_differences.interpretation: No sustained CPU/heap collapse or persistent stage-cost increase is shown. The arm/disarm comparison is short, ordered, and corrupted at trace serialization; it cannot prove zero observer effect or explain R7.

verified_differences.evidence: R2 is a diagnostic build with outlier trace; R7 production qualification has no valid per-frame trace records. R2 retained five over-threshold records, but all serialize malformed.
verified_differences.interpretation: No valid same-frame stage attribution is available; R2 p99 below threshold does not invalidate the original R7 failure.

root_cause.confidence: high that the original R7 p99 gate failure is real in the preserved run; low/none on causal source attribution
root_cause.reason: The R7 stage aggregates do not correlate to individual slow frame IDs. R2 differs in runtime age, cumulative histogram sample count/reset window, read cadence and diagnostic instrumentation, and its outlier records cannot be parsed.

recommended_next_measurement.reason: Corrected R2 build makes the previously unavailable same-frame traces parseable; existing R2 has only five malformed records at runtime <625 s, whereas R7 tail failure began at 1414 s. This adds information unavailable from current files.
recommended_next_measurement.scope: One fresh exact diagnostic install and one exact R4 return only after new authorization; no production deployment or R8.
recommended_next_measurement.sequence: After fresh preflight/authority, install once; keep kernel 13, Caleido3 variant 1347100685, brightness 44, and all other runtime controls as recorded/matched. Maintain identical 8-second five-endpoint safety polling throughout. Reach uptime >=1390 s before timed windows to cover the prior onset region. Collect trace-disarmed then trace-armed windows of 600 seconds each (20 min total), resetting cumulative histogram to zero immediately before each timed window after identical 2-second settle. No p99 exclusion. Stop collection, read/parse trace, restore the exact renderer snapshot, then return once to R4 SHA 338afdf5e40e83f8887246c0d9e7e67e9b55caca4912f6b2ae743a2f3d8c and verify identity/health/AUX DDP.
recommended_next_measurement.expected_sample_size: At approximately 41 FPS, ~24,600 frames per 10-minute condition; around 246 observations occupy the empirical top 1% under stationary independent sampling. Frame autocorrelation and rare-event recurrence mean this improves p99 resolution but cannot guarantee a rare spike will recur.
recommended_next_measurement.live_stop_rule: Retain the unchanged catastrophic three-consecutive-sample abort and AUX safety checks; p99 >42.03125 ms is evidence, not an abort. Any identity/recovery/health failure is fail-closed. No extensions or repeat transaction.
recommended_next_measurement.evidence: Exact R4 rollback available and SHA-verified offline; no device preflight/authority in this task.
